sentences.text: X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism, a movement disorder affecting men of Filipino heritage, is caused by a specific genetic insertion in the TAF1 gene.
In a mouse model carrying this human mutation, male subjects displayed severe movement problems and striatal shrinkage.
Brain analyses revealed reduced myelin-producing cells and myelin damage in both the mice and human tissue, including the medial prefrontal cortex.
The authors suggest that these myelin-related issues are major factors in the disease.
